snippet.title: Shroud of Gloom - Alpha Teaser [OUTDATED]
snippet.description:
🧡 *WISHLIST THE GAME* ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3453420/Shroud_of_Gloom/ 🧡
Shroud of Gloom is a point-and-click horror game. Solve puzzles, collect items and uncover secrets with nothing but a flickering flashlight to guide your way. Can you survive the dark and make it out alive? The game combines the charm and nostalgia of classic point-and-click games with a chilling horror atmosphere. It was originally created for the GDFG's Monthly Game Jam, where it ranked #1 in every category - Now coming to Steam as a longer & improved version.
Play the jam version here ► https://madchirpy.itch.io/shroud-of-gloom
